response.overview: 4 Orphan Kids from India, getting a chance of a lifetime to come to Los Angeles and live with a wealthy Man. What they didn't expect is that they would have to use their street smarts. A Butler with a funny sense of humor, a housekeeper who is up something. The Social worker not easily impressed and twist no one saw coming. Many messages that will have you laughing and maybe shed a tear to two. Simply a feel good movie.
response.tagline: Four orphan kids from India get a once-in-a-lifetime chance to live with a wealthy man in Los Angeles, but they do not expect to have to use their street smarts.
response.title: The Switch Up
